record.paper_title: Conjectures and Open Questions on the Structure and Regularity of Spaces with Lower Ricci Curvature Bounds
record.original_question: Suppose a sequence of pointed Riemannian manifolds (M_i^n, g_i, p_i) converges in the Gromov–Hausdorff sense to a metric space (X, d, p), with Ric_i ≥ −λ and Vol(B_1(p_i)) > v > 0. Is X homeomorphic to a manifold outside a singular subset of codimension three?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.4. Let Mni, gi, pi → (X, d, p) satisfy Rici ≥ −λ and Vol(B1(pi)) > v > 0, then X is homeomorphic to a manifold away from a set of codimension three.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$, $\lambda\ge 0$, and $v>0$. Suppose $(M_i^n, g_i, p_i)$ is a sequence of pointed complete $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds satisfying
$$\mathrm{Ric}_{g_i} \ge -\lambda \quad\text{and}\quad \mathrm{Vol}(B_1(p_i)) \ge v,$$
and that $(M_i^n, g_i, p_i)$ converges in the pointed Gromov–Hausdorff sense to a metric space $(X, d, p)$. Such a limit $X$ is called a noncollapsed Ricci limit space. Prove or disprove: there exists a closed subset $S\subseteq X$ with Hausdorff codimension at least $3$ such that $X\setminus S$ is a topological manifold (equivalently, $X$ is homeomorphic to a topological manifold away from a set of codimension three).
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears to be still open in general. Recent work (2024) establishes topological manifold structure for noncollapsed Ricci limits at points where all tangent cones are $(n-3)$-symmetric, and shows that noncollapsed RCD spaces are topological manifolds (possibly with boundary) up to a set of codimension two. The codimension-four conjecture (under two-sided bounded Ricci) is proven by Cheeger–Naber, but the lower-Ricci codimension-three topological regularity conjecture is not yet fully established.

status_evidence.title: Topological regularity and stability of noncollapsed spaces with Ricci curvature bounded below
status_evidence.snippet: (n-3)-symmetric noncollapsed Ricci limits are topological manifolds, confirming a particular case of a conjecture due to Cheeger, Colding, and Tian.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: conjecture confirmed only under additional symmetry assumptions on tangent cones.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of Einstein Manifolds and the Codimension 4 Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Noncollapsed limits of manifolds with bounded Ricci curvature are smooth away from a closed set of codimension 4.
status_evidence.claim: Related codimension-4 result holds under two-sided Ricci bounds; the lower-Ricci codimension-3 topological version remains conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Boundary regularity and stability for spaces with Ricci bounded below
status_evidence.snippet: Noncollapsed RCD spaces are homeomorphic to topological manifolds (possibly with boundary) up to sets of codimension two.
status_evidence.claim: Topological manifold structure is currently established only up to codimension two.
